atoms.statement: Each metric has versioned owner, grain, identity, cohort, time, dimensions, units, authorization, quality, aggregation and oracle.
Sum only disjoint compatible contributions; booked/fulfilled/movement and product/service are separate.
Target-grain exact identity union, never sum child distinct counts without proved disjointness.
Balance snapshot at one as-of, not sum over time.
Recompute operands at target grain; zero denominator not measurable, unknown missing/partial.
Recompute non-additive statistics from sufficient statistics or facts.
Versioned decimal precision/rounding; missing distinct from zero, no approximate replacement for exact.
Tenant and warehouse rights before aggregation; no leakage via denominator, total, cache or drilldown.
Historical category/geography and warehouse grain; no invented allocation; AS_BOOKED and RESTATED separate.
Consistent applicable L0–L3 semantics, exact membership, no additive join fanout or overlapping period sum.
Late events, rollback, replay, rebuild and revision fence preserve math and provenance.
TASK owns single classification authority; SQL exact durations, Java mapping only; H2 parity.
Validate unique completion and archive/version chain; conflicting or missing evidence cannot fabricate completion.
Validate contiguous event and due-change history; tri-state deadline change and unknown evidence preserved.
One trusted microsecond cutoff; future completion AFTER_CUTOFF; exact signed numeric durations.
EARLY_50 iff valid completion with positive plan, nonnegative elapsed and 2*elapsed<=planned; late comparison precedes.
Active overdue only eligible status/assignee/due; exact equality and 24h boundary, severity 24h/72h.
Safe title vocabulary; no raw title, PII or raw events.
Fresh TASK_READ and tenant+creator/current assignee; no implicit owner or manager broad access.
All filters before LIMIT; half-open IANA zone range, max93 days; undated only DUE.
Stable keyset date/id; limit1..100+1; bind cursor to actor/tenant/filter and fresh admission every page.
Storage verification outside transaction; admit then consumer lock then lockVerified within READ COMMITTED.
Attachment, owner publication transition and required canonical event/intent atomically; AVAILABLE not PUBLISHED.
Reconcile orphan intent/object; never delete referenced object; retry stable identity/fence.
Catalog reads authoritative metadata with fresh authorization independent of event projection.
Minimal typed event payload; no secrets/PII/storage key or URL; reauthorize read/delivery/open.
Independent consumer receipts; no global order/exactly once; stale event cannot restore revoked report.
PDF separate admission; logical occurrence vs format artifact; no duplicate ready notification.
Scheduled deadline from qualified occurrence; Radar and EVT trigger admission separate.
